# QR Vision

> Free, privacy-first, 100% client-side online QR code scanner, 1D barcode scanner, and static QR code generator that runs directly in any modern browser with zero server uploads.

QR Vision processes all camera streams, uploaded images, and PDF documents locally inside the user's browser using JavaScript. No images, camera feeds, or decoded data ever leave the device.

## Core Tools

- [Online QR Code Scanner](https://qrvision.github.io/): Scan QR codes via live camera, batch images (up to 20), PDFs, drag-and-drop, or clipboard paste (`Ctrl+V`) with built-in anti-phishing URL safety checks.
- [Online Barcode Scanner](https://qrvision.github.io/barcode.html): Decode EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 128, and Code 39 barcodes locally in your browser.
- [Free QR Code Generator](https://qrvision.github.io/generator.html): Create permanent, non-expiring static QR codes (PNG and vector SVG) for URLs, plain text, Wi-Fi, vCards, UPI payments, emails, and phones.

## Languages

- [English](https://qrvision.github.io/): Main English QR scanner
- [Português (Brasil)](https://qrvision.github.io/pt/): Leitor de QR Code Online
- [Français](https://qrvision.github.io/fr/): Lecteur QR Code en Ligne
- [Español](https://qrvision.github.io/es/): Escáner de Códigos QR Online
- [हिन्दी](https://qrvision.github.io/hi/): ऑनलाइन QR कोड स्कैनर
